title: Operation “Date Bait”: AI-enabled scam targeting loveseekers
summary: OpenAI banned accounts that very likely originated in Cambodia and used AI for scam outreach to Indonesian loveseekers, including translation and engagement.
body: OpenAI banned accounts that very likely originated in Cambodia and used AI for scam outreach to Indonesian loveseekers, including translation and engagement.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了源自柬埔寨的账户，这些账户利用AI进行针对印尼用户的浪漫诈骗，包括自动化翻译和互动。该案例揭示了AI在降低诈骗门槛方面的风险。
